issues: The central manipulation was sintering temperature across 850, 900, 950, and 1000 °C, not SPS at 1000 °C alone.
The stated 800–1000 °C condition is imprecise: experiments used 850–1000 °C, while temperatures below 800 °C were only discussed as inadequate.

AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 precipitate at 1000 °C, but the paper does not identify all of them equally as uniformly distributed barrier phases; MgAl2O4 and FeAl2O4 receive the clearest barrier/passive-film role.
The mechanism overattributes passive-film formation to high temperature and pressure together, although pressure was fixed and only sintering temperature was varied.
The lower boundary does not establish that every temperature at or above 800 °C yields density above 80%.
